chunks.heading: Continuous Assessment & Grade Discrepancy
chunks.content: A student identifying an inconsistency between evaluated continuous assessment (CA) marks and the marks uploaded on the University Grade Management System may register an official grievance within 7 working days of marks publication. The course instructor and Head of Department must verify the physical and digital evaluation rubric and rectify any clerical data-entry error within 5 working days.

chunks.heading: Course Registration & Credit Overload
chunks.content: The standard semester registration limit is 26 academic credits. Under exceptional circumstances, students with a cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 8.00 or higher may apply for an overload of up to 4 additional credits, subject to approval by the School Dean and confirmation of timetable clash-free scheduling.

chunks.heading: Academic Appeals & Attendance Condonation
chunks.content: Official duty leaves sanctioned for representing the university in recognized national competitions, academic conferences, or authorized sports meets are credited toward attendance calculations up to a maximum ceiling of 10% total lecture hours, provided formal documentation is lodged within 3 days of return.

chunks.heading: Course Drop & Withdrawal Deadlines
chunks.content: Students may officially withdraw from an elective course without academic penalty up to the end of the 4th teaching week of the semester. Withdrawn courses are designated with a 'W' grade on the provisional transcript and carry no credit or grade penalty.

chunks.heading: Temporary Semester Deferment (Break in Studies)
chunks.content: Students requesting a formal break in studies for certified personal or entrepreneurial reasons must submit an application endorsed by the Academic Advisor and Dean. Deferment is granted for a maximum continuous duration of two regular semesters without forfeiture of registration.
chunks.excerpt: Students requesting a formal break in studies for certified personal or entrepreneurial reasons must submit an application endorsed by the Academic Advisor and Dean. Deferment is granted for a maximum continuous duration of two regular semesters without forfeiture of registration.

chunks.heading: Hall Ticket / Admit Card Clearance Holds
chunks.content: Admit cards are generated 7 days prior to End Term Examinations. In the event of an erroneous administrative hold (such as library return delay or laboratory dues), the student may present an official clearance counter receipt. The Examination Branch is authorized to execute an emergency temporary clearance override within 4 hours to guarantee the student's right to appear in the examination.

chunks.heading: Answer Script Re-evaluation Procedure & Timeline
chunks.content: Applications for formal answer script re-evaluation must be submitted via the student portal within 10 calendar days of end-term result declaration. A prescribed fee of Rs. 500 per theoretical course applies. If the revised score varies by more than 15% from the original evaluation, a third external evaluator assesses the paper and the median score is finalized.

chunks.heading: Examination Absence on Medical Grounds & Special Exam
chunks.content: Students absent from an end-term exam due to certified acute medical emergency or hospitalization must submit certified medical documents endorsed by the University Health Center within 48 hours of the missed exam. Eligible students are permitted to take the Special Supplementary Examination without paying arrear examination fees.

chunks.heading: Examination Timetable Clashes
chunks.content: When a student has two examinations scheduled concurrently in the same session due to backlog or re-registered courses, the Examination Branch will arrange a consecutive examination seating slot in the secure examination control center with monitored quarantine between shifts.
chunks.excerpt: When a student has two examinations scheduled concurrently in the same session due to backlog or re-registered courses, the Examination Branch will arrange a consecutive examination seating slot in the secure examination control center with monitored quarantine between shifts.

chunks.document_title: Hostel Code of Conduct & Maintenance Regulations
chunks.heading: Appliance & Electrical Fixture Maintenance
chunks.content: Maintenance requests for electrical and air conditioning issues must be inspected by the maintenance supervisor within 24 hours of ticket submission. If replacement of parts is required, the standard resolution window is 48 hours. Emergency issues involving water leakage near electrical fixtures must be treated as priority hazard cases and attended within 4 hours.

chunks.document_title: Hostel Code of Conduct & Maintenance Regulations
chunks.heading: Plumbing, Sanitation & Hygiene Protocol
chunks.content: Sanitary complaints, including washroom blockages, water purifier malfunctions, and hot water geyser defects, require immediate inspection by the block facility executive within 12 hours. Water purifier filters undergo mandatory preventative servicing on the 1st of every calendar month.

chunks.heading: Room Mutual Transfer & Allocation Guidelines
chunks.content: Mutual room change requests between registered hostellers of the same accommodation tier and gender are permitted during the official window from Day 7 to Day 21 of each semester. Both students must submit written mutual consent endorsed by their respective block wardens.

chunks.document_title: University Fee Payment, Gateway Settlement & Refund Regulations
chunks.heading: Duplicate Online Payment Settlement
chunks.content: In cases where a student's bank account is debited multiple times for a single semester fee installment due to payment gateway timeout, the excess amount is reconciled within 3 working days with the payment aggregator. Refunds for confirmed duplicate debits are credited back to the source bank account within 7 to 10 working days upon submission of the bank debit advice.

chunks.heading: Semester Withdrawal Fee Refund Schedule
chunks.clause: Clause 11.2 (Pro-Rata Tuition Fee Refund on Formal Cancellation)
chunks.content: When a student cancels admission or withdraws prior to the official commencement of orientation, a 100% refund is processed with a deduction of Rs. 1,000 as processing charges. Withdrawals within 15 days of commencement yield 80% tuition refund; within 30 days yields 50%; withdrawals exceeding 30 days carry no tuition refund entitlement.

chunks.clause: Clause 14.1 (Late Fee Waiver on Certified Educational Loan Delay)
chunks.content: Students awaiting disbursement of bank educational loans may seek late fee fine condonation by presenting an official sanction letter from a scheduled commercial bank. The Comptroller of Finance is empowered to grant an extension of up to 30 days without penalty.

chunks.content: Institutional verification for state and national scholarship portals (including NSP, PMS, and State Welfare Portals) must be completed by the designated Nodal Officer at least 5 days prior to the statutory portal closing date. Students must ensure their Aadhaar linkage, fee receipt, and enrolled status are verified in the central registry.

chunks.heading: Merit-cum-Means Renewal CGPA Thresholds
chunks.content: To maintain continuity of institutional merit-cum-means scholarship waivers, recipients must maintain a minimum CGPA of 7.50 without any standing backlog or disciplinary sanctions. Failure to meet the academic threshold results in temporary suspension of tuition fee concession for the subsequent term.

chunks.document_title: Campus Digital Infrastructure, Wi-Fi & Account Access Policy
chunks.heading: Device Quota and MAC Address Re-binding
chunks.clause: Clause 2.4 (Device Quota and MAC Address Re-binding)
chunks.content: Each registered student is allotted two active device MAC registrations on the campus secure wireless network. When an existing device is deleted, RADIUS synchronization takes up to 60 minutes to flush stale leases. In case of persistent allocation lockouts, IT helpdesk personnel can execute a manual RADIUS session reset.

chunks.document_title: Campus Digital Infrastructure, Wi-Fi & Account Access Policy
chunks.heading: Student Portal Password & Security Lockout Recovery
chunks.content: Five consecutive unsuccessful login attempts on the student portal trigger a 30-minute security lockout. Students may unlock their account immediately via OTP authentication delivered to their registered mobile number. For compromised credentials, IT security operations will force an immediate credential reset.

chunks.document_title: Student Welfare, Medical Condonation & Grievance By-Laws
chunks.heading: Medical Leave Attendance Condonation
chunks.clause: Section 7, Clause 7.2 (Medical Leave Attendance Condonation Protocol)
chunks.content: Students experiencing severe illness or hospitalization may apply for medical leave duty adjustment. The application must be supported by a certified discharge summary from a registered medical hospital and endorsed by the University Health Center within 5 days of recovery. If approved, attendance credit of up to a maximum of 10% (reducing minimum eligibility threshold from 75% to 65%) is granted.

chunks.heading: Student Emergency Financial Assistance
chunks.content: The Student Welfare Directorate maintains an emergency relief grant for students facing sudden personal distress or loss of sole earning parent during the academic term. Grants up to Rs. 25,000 for immediate living subsistence are sanctioned upon recommendation of the Student Welfare Committee.
